_headline: CONTRADICTS the prior finding that every conditionalFieldsConfig is empty. 8 of 135 layouts carry populated conditional-field rules: 2 LIST page layouts and 6 Issue/Form layouts. 33 raw json.conditionalFieldsConfig values were captured verbatim.

howFormLayoutsAreEnumerated.step1: GET /en/admin/FirmCodeList.jsp?ajaxList=true&ajax=true&popupList=true&BOType=CodeIssueType&start=0&limit=5000 -> the code-table directory (207 entries); the row 'Issue Type Code' carries TableType=2035.
howFormLayoutsAreEnumerated.step2: GET /en/admin/FirmCodeEdit.jsp?popupList=true&includeType=Manage&TableType=2035&ajaxList=true&ajax=true&start=0&limit=5000 -> the 6 Issue Types. Each topic's expandedHtml embeds its form-layout table.
howFormLayoutsAreEnumerated.step3: Each row of that table links: LayoutEditorAJAX.jsp?PageLayoutID={id}&formSubmit=editBO&popupEdit=true&buildLayout=true&layoutMode=form&CodeIssueTypeID={issueTypeId}
howFormLayoutsAreEnumerated.note: mode=ISSUE and mode=FORM on SummaryEntityPageLayoutEdit.jsp are NOT valid - they silently fall back to mode=SEP and return the same 15 summary layouts. Form layouts are reachable only through the Issue Type.

sweepVector.why: One cheap GET per layout renders a 'Field | Rule | Criteria' table, or the sentinel text 'There are no conditional fields in this layout.' Far cheaper than driving ConditionFilterEx per field. Works for SEP/SUB/LIST and form layouts alike.
sweepVector.semanticNote: The page states verbatim: 'Conditions affect the edit layout and NOT the list layout.' So a condition attached to a LIST layout governs the edit form reached from that list, not the grid itself.

rawConfigVector.finding: CustomObjectDelID is NOT required - fieldKey + pageLayoutID is sufficient. Verified by fetching the same field with and without the hash and getting byte-identical config. This removes the need to render the builder just to mint a per-session cell hash (the builder is still needed to learn which rgafIDs a layout contains).
rawConfigVector.extract: regex on the response: name='json.conditionalFieldsConfig' value='({...})'  - the same JSON is repeated in an Ext.onReady block as 'var jsonConfig = {...}'.
rawConfigVector.builderConstraint: Derived: only ONE LayoutEditorAJAX builder can be open per session. Eight iframes loaded concurrently all collided and only one produced a populated DOM. Renders must be serialised.

conditionalFieldsConfigSchema._evidence: Derived from 33 observed values plus the observed select vocabularies on ConditionFilterEx.jsp.

criteriaFields.scriptName: data-field script name of the DRIVING field, e.g. Issue.LAR_RequestType
crtVal1: one or more code values, by display string not id

operatorCodesObserved.17: not in (rendered as '<field> id not in <values>')

conditionalFieldsConfigSchema.note: Only crtOpt1/crtVal1 were ever populated in BBW; the '1' suffix implies the engine supports a second operand slot (crtOpt2/crtVal2) that this tenant never uses. Inferred.
conditionalFieldsConfigSchema.valuesAreLabels: crtVal1 holds display strings ('Estoppel', 'New Lease', 'Yes', 'Vendor Change'), not numeric code ids. Observed.

_supersedes: The ConditionalFieldsForLayout.jsp HTML sweep recorded here first was confirmed and then superseded by a REST sweep, which reads the stored JSON directly. Both agree: 8 layouts, 50 conditional-field records.

definitiveMethod.why: Returns the PageLayout with its PageLayoutField children. Each child's JSONConfigText is the stored JSON blob; conditionalFieldsConfig is a key INSIDE it, as a nested object (not a string). This is the storage form - no rendering, no builder session, no per-field popup.
definitiveMethod.supersedes: Both ConditionalFieldsForLayout.jsp (rendered HTML) and ConditionFilterEx.jsp (per-field popup). Those remain useful for reading the human-rendered rule text.
definitiveMethod.coverage: 134 of 135 layouts returned 200. PageLayoutID 101799 ('VC Submit Vendor Changes', Vendor Changes (Integration)) returned 401 and is the single gap.
definitiveMethod.storageLocation: PageLayoutField.JSONConfigText -> key 'conditionalFieldsConfig'. There is NO conditionalFieldsConfig on PageLayout itself; it is strictly per-field.

remainingGaps: PageLayoutID 101799 returned 401 over REST; its conditional state is unknown. The HTML sweep did read it and reported 'empty', so it is very likely to have none.
No layout in BBW uses showHide='hide' or 'showAndRequire', or allAny='any', or a second operand slot (crtOpt2/crtVal2). Those code paths exist in the UI but are unexercised here.
